headline: A5 PROP receives a trading suspension and termination of listing status, a high‑impact filing for the PROP sector.
market_take: The market shows mixed momentum: TTCL and GEL posted 5‑day gains of +33.3% each, while KC fell -33.3% over the same period. Unusual trading was evident across several sectors, with volume spikes at VPO (+10.6σ) and TNPF (+12.1σ) and price gaps at AQUA (+11.11% open gap) and XBIO (-14.29% open gap). Notable filings include the death of TFMAMA's chairman, capital reductions at CPNCG and TTLPF, and multiple share‑repurchase disclosures. Investors should watch the PROP and FOOD sectors for heightened volatility.

sector_notes.note: A5 PROP faces a trading suspension and delisting risk; KC recorded a -33.3% 5‑day decline, and AKS received an SP delisting sign.
AQUA showed an +11.11% open‑gap followed by a -10.00% intraday drop, XBIO posted a -14.29% open‑gap and filed AGM resolutions, and TFMAMA announced its chairman's passing.
VPO surged with a volume spike of 10.6σ and a +9.09% intraday move, while TFM logged a 4.9σ volume spike.
PLE displayed a +12.50% open‑gap and a -11.11% intraday move, and several firms (BJCHI, DEMCO, TRITN) filed share‑repurchase reports.
TNPF recorded a 12.1σ volume spike, CPNCG announced a capital reduction, and TTLPF also reduced its paid‑up capital.
